metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the project-onboard plugin. Add this repo as a marketplace, then install the plugin from it.

plugins.name: project-onboard
plugins.description: New-project bootstrapper: scaffolder script + judgment runbook that takes a project from nothing to a consistent standard — private GitHub repo (public only on explicit request), pinned per-repo git identity, project CLAUDE.md, CodeRabbit config on main from day one, serena onboarding (full six-memory set), and a quantitative verification gate.
